description: Claim store credit for a purchase that did not work, within 24 hours; one claim per order. We verify on our side (our own test run or our service logs) before crediting; test_output and detail are kept on file, but only our records decide. The answer says credited or rejected, and why. Once credited, a kit gives no more download links and a utility loses that order's paid time. Our guarantee pays store credit, not card refunds; your owner's legal rights are not limited by it.
